svg.title: Backpropagation through time on a 3-step scalar RNN
svg.desc: Forward values h1 = 0.4621, h2 = 0.5509, h3 = -0.0592 and loss 0.2173; deltas -0.6569, -0.3660, -0.2303 shrink by 0.557 and 0.629 per step; the gradients for the shared w and u sum one term per step.
svg.text: ht​ = tanh(w xt​ + u ht−1​), w = 0.5, u = 0.8,
Blue w and orange u are the same two numbers in every
step. Each step adds one term to their gradient (sum over
time), while the delta travelling back (up here) is multiplied
by u · tanh' at every step (product over time).
